Attention lapse.hazard: Driver attention is not sustained while steering assistance is active.
Attention lapse.safeguard: Attention monitoring prompts escalation and disengagement.
Attention lapse.intendedOutcome: The driver responds to the attention prompt and resumes appropriate supervision.
Attention lapse.successCriterion: A response is recorded under the referenced synthetic test protocol.

Mode transition.hazard: The driver does not recognise that steering assistance is ending.
Mode transition.safeguard: The interface provides a clear transition alert.
Mode transition.intendedOutcome: The driver recognises the transition and resumes appropriate control.
Mode transition.successCriterion: Recognition and response are recorded under the referenced synthetic test protocol.

Operating boundary.hazard: Steering assistance remains in use outside its declared operating boundary.
Operating boundary.safeguard: Boundary detection warns the driver and restricts assistance.
Operating boundary.intendedOutcome: The driver exits or corrects the unsupported operating condition.
Operating boundary.successCriterion: The unsupported condition is corrected under the referenced synthetic test protocol.
